turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Magandang hapon po! Si Lia po ito, virtual assistant ng Kalinga Life, partner ng Bayanihan Bank. Para po sa quality at training purposes, naka-record po ang tawag na ito. Si Ma'am Reyes po ba ang kausap ko?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, this is Ana Reyes speaking

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, Ma'am. For security, may I have the last four digits of your policy number?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sorry, that doesn't match our record. Could you say the last four digits again?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, you're verified. I'm calling to remind you that your quarterly premium for Kalinga Protect, 7,350 pesos, is due on Wednesday, October 7. If you need a little more time, there's a 31-day grace period from the due date. When do you think you'll be able to pay?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Actually I have a question about a claim for my husband, can I talk to an advisor?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course, I'm passing you to a Kalinga Life advisor. One moment please.
